propositions: Grounding finders (G1G2/E4/E6) flag symbols as missing/unverifiable when they are created by a prerequisite ticket, despite documented rules stating such symbols should be treated as existing
The `[rebar:<ticket-id>]` inline citation grammar enables plans to reference functionality from prerequisite tickets, verified bidirectionally via depends_on or blocks relationships
Layer-1 (det_citation.py) provides advisory edge verification: citations with verified edges (P depends_on C or C blocks P) are backed; unbacked citations yield advisory coaching without blocking

Layer-2 (G1G2/E4/E6 rubrics) specifies LLM coverage judgment protocol: when a grounding finder would flag a symbol as missing, the reviewer uses show_ticket to confirm whether the cited prerequisite actually provides that functionality before crediting the citation
Error handling ensures failed reverse-lookups (network/store/missing-ticket) treat citations as unverified rather than propagating exceptions, maintaining fail-open semantics

Behavioral evaluation confirms Layer-2 protocol correctly credits verified+covered citations (5/5 samples) and withholds credit from edge-unbacked or coverage-absent citations (5/5 samples), meeting >=80% threshold
